title: Growth, Endurance & Perseverance
description: Following Jesus is a lifelong race, not a sprint. God grows us through hard seasons and promises to finish the good work he started.

waypoints.title: A Lifelong Race
waypoints.body: God doesn't grow us all at once -- he grows us through seasons, including hard ones. Every struggle is a chance for him to build something stronger in us.

waypoints.title: Kept Going
waypoints.body: What's something hard you kept trying at even when you wanted to quit? How did God help you keep going?
